emails.subject: Next Steps
emails.bodyHtml:
{{1.emailSalutation}},

It's {{77.PC.`Full Name`}}, and now is the time to hand you over to the best part of our company, the production team. The first and most important step: shortly, you will receive an introduction email from our Director of Operations, {{77.COO.`Full Name`}}. She will ask you to go through the "Project Preparation Overview" form and confirm the start date. Please complete this as soon as possible, since only that will move your project into the next stage.

Here is what happens after that:
  • You will receive an email from an assigned project manager no later than 4 weeks before the project starts. If your start date is less than 4 weeks away, you will hear from your project manager shortly after you confirm your start date with {{77.COO.F_Name}}. The project manager will be your primary point of contact throughout the entire project.
  • Your project manager will give you an overview of the next steps (through online forms), introduce you to your interior designer and provide you with more details on the process.
  • You will also receive an email from your interior designer with a general overview of the process for selecting your finishes.
  • A few days before your start date, your project manager will send you a list of the items you will need to select throughout the project. This is not something you need to start working on immediately. You may begin after the pre-construction meeting.
Lastly, thank you for putting your faith in me and our company. You are in great hands! Please feel free to contact me with any questions in the meantime.

Best,
{{77.PC.`Full Name`}}

emails.subject: Invitation email from BasementRemodeling.com! Please go over it carefully and let us know if you have any questions.
emails.bodyHtml:
Hello {{47.Salutation}}!

This is {{49.COO.F_Name}} {{49.COO.L_Name}}, Director of Operations here at BasementRemodeling.com.

First, let me thank you for choosing BasementRemodeling.com for your upcoming basement project. We are looking forward to making your vision come true! We will do our best to exceed your expectations for both the process and the final product. Welcome to the BasementRemodeling.com family!

The purpose of this email is to:

{{if(47.Demo != true; "

1. Set a date for a pre-construction meeting. Please note the pre-construction meeting takes 2-3 hours and it works better for everyone if all of the decision makers are present. At the moment, we have the following date available: " + formatDate(38.precon; "dddd, MMMM Do, YYYY") + " at " + formatDate(38.precon; "h:mm A") + ".
You can reply to this email with confirmation or with the request for another date. You can also simply CLICK HERE to confirm the meeting with a single click.

"; "

1. Set dates for pre-demolition and pre-construction meetings. Please note that the pre-demolition meeting lasts for about 30 minutes while the pre-construction meeting generally takes 2-3 hours. It is important that all of the decision makers are present for the pre-construction meeting. At the moment, we have the following dates available:
Pre-demo meeting: " + formatDate(39.predemo; "dddd, MMMM Do, YYYY") + " at " + formatDate(39.predemo; "h:mm A") + ".
Pre-con meeting: " + formatDate(38.precon; "dddd, MMMM Do, YYYY") + " at " + formatDate(38.precon; "h:mm A") + ".
You can reply to this email with confirmation or with a request for other dates. You can also simply CLICK HERE to confirm both meetings with a single click.

")}}

2. Provide full clarity about the next steps and overall understanding of the pre-construction stage of the project. We use a custom-made online form to guide you through this important process. Please, CLICK HERE to be forwarded to our Project preparation overview form. It is essential to go through the entire form before confirming the date of the pre-construction meeting.

Once we confirm the {{if(56.Demo != true; "date"; "dates")}}, your project manager will follow up via email with the next steps to help us plan the project. As you think about a start date, please keep in mind that we need the work areas of the basement completely emptied out by the time of the pre-construction meeting.

Please let us know if you have any questions. We are excited to start the project and to get to know you!


Best Regards,
